title: Go-live
help: Run alongside your old system until you are ready. Billing and member emails stay off until you turn them on here.
billingHelp: Allow automatic collection, retries and staff card charges. Turning billing off pauses new charges; payments already started at Stripe can still complete.
memberEmailsHelp: Send receipts, payment reminders, card-expiry notices and signed links. Staff invitations, security emails and owner alerts continue while this is off.
check.members_imported.needs_attention: Import your members or add them by hand.
check.schedule_ready.ready: Your class schedule is set up.
check.schedule_ready.needs_attention: Add your classes to the schedule.
check.cards_collected.not_applicable: No paid memberships to collect yet, or payments are not configured.
check.cards_collected.ready: Every household with a paid membership has a saved default card.
check.cards_collected.needs_attention: Some households with paid memberships need a saved default card.
check.waivers_signed.not_applicable: No active members or current waiver templates to check.
check.waivers_signed.ready: Active members have signed every current waiver and agreement.
check.waivers_signed.needs_attention: Some active members still need to sign a current waiver or agreement.
check.smtp_ready.needs_attention: Configure email delivery so members receive emails.
check.backup_ready.needs_attention: Configure backups before you rely on this app.
check.webhook_ready.ready: Payment notifications have been processed, with none waiting or failed.
check.webhook_ready.needs_attention: Wait for a processed payment notification and resolve any waiting or failed events on the health page.
check.reconciliation_complete.ready: No unresolved payment attempts or refunds remain, and any restored payments have been checked.
check.reconciliation_complete.needs_atte: Resolve pending payment attempts or refunds. After a restore, complete payment reconciliation before resuming billing.
check.past_due_dates.ready: No active membership has a next billing date before today in the gym's timezone.
check.past_due_dates.needs_attention: Review the memberships below before turning billing on.
pastDueHelp: These active memberships have next billing dates before the gym's local today. Billing catches up missed periods. If your old system already collected them, correct their dates before turning billing on to avoid charging twice. Periods more than seven days old are held for review.
confirmDates: I reviewed these dates and confirm these periods have not already been collected by the old system.
confirmEnable: Confirm dates and turn billing on
confirmChanged: Review and confirm the latest past billing dates before turning billing on.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
changed: These settings changed elsewhere. The latest values are shown; try again.
reconcileHelp: After resolving payment issues, check again before turning billing on. This check never turns billing on.
reconcilePending: No completed result for the latest check yet. You can run the check again if it was interrupted.
reconcilePause: Pause billing before checking restored payments.
reconcileError: The payment check failed. Billing stays paused. Check your payment configuration and try again.
unavailable: Go-live settings are not available right now.
